name: folio
description: A quiet, native Markdown reader for macOS.

scripts.bench: cargo bench -p folio-core --bench render 2>&1 | tee bench/criterion.txt
scripts.preview: node scripts/build-ui.mjs && node scripts/fixtures.mjs && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.verify: cargo test && cargo clippy -p folio-core -p folio-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:e2e
